We've had two nasty production incidents on our paycorp-service project: a contractor's AI assistant rewrote our payment validation logic from scratch (introducing subtle bugs) and another time someone committed an API key directly into the codebase. We now have an agent-guardrails toolkit available at /workspace/agent-guardrails that's supposed to prevent exactly these problems.

Please set up the full guardrail infrastructure on our project at /workspace/paycorp-service. Once that's done, we need a new file called payment_utils.py added to the project — it should expose convenient helper utilities that build on top of our existing payment code (don't rewrite anything that already exists). Finally, make sure we also have deployment verification in place so the team can catch 'code written but not wired in' mistakes before they hit production.

The goal is a properly protected project where the mechanical enforcement hooks are active, payment_utils.py is clean and compliant, and the deployment verification artifacts are all in place.
